target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Ashtabula-based nonprofit focused on entrepreneurial education. Mission: 'Education & Support for Entrepreneurs' — helping start or grow businesses. Approach: Collaborate, Educate, Connect, Support. Programs: Entrepreneurship courses, Startup & Growth Resources, Peer Support Group Programs (monthly discussions, expert speakers, quarterly coaching, mentor network). Inclusive space for entrepreneurs to achieve financial goals and foster community growth. Social presence: Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram. Created by Pipe! Creative. Educational resources platform would complement their existing workshops and peer support groups perfectly.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Offers Entrepreneurship undergraduate certificate addressing needs of small business managers and future business owners. Also covers intrapreneurship (innovative risk taking) for employees in larger organizations. Other relevant certificates: Business Management Technology, Brewing Technology, Enology, Event Management, Hospitality Management — all supporting Ashtabula County's business ecosystem. Local SBDC educational resources would benefit their students and broader community. Certificate coursework available on-campus, online, and hybrid formats.
